note: Taylor County GA (FIPS 13269) has a Planning & Zoning department and zones, but its zoning districts are published only as static PDF maps (the City of Butler's 'Zoning Map with Parcels' is a PDF). Searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub, the county site, the Middle Georgia Regional Commission GIS pages and the Schneider qPublic/Beacon viewer found no queryable zoning district service. The qPublic viewer was blocked to automated access (403), and the county's own parcel GIS is not a zoning-district layer.
